# Live Video Stack
> Live Video Stack provides APIs, SDKs, and infrastructure for building live streaming, video conferencing, and real-time media applications.

Live Video Stack offers developer-focused products for ingest, playback, recording, conferencing, and media workflows, with documentation covering platform setup, APIs, SDKs, and implementation guides.

## Documentation
- [Documentation Home](https://docs.live-video.net/): Main entry point for product documentation, guides, and developer resources.
- [Getting Started](https://docs.live-video.net/getting-started): Overview for starting with Live Video Stack products and workflows.
- [Guides](https://docs.live-video.net/guides): Practical implementation guides for common live video and streaming use cases.
- [API Reference](https://docs.live-video.net/api-reference): Reference documentation for platform APIs and endpoints.
- [SDKs](https://docs.live-video.net/sdks): SDK documentation for integrating live video capabilities into applications.
- [Webhooks](https://docs.live-video.net/webhooks): Documentation for event notifications and webhook-based integrations.

## Core Platform
- [Live Streaming](https://docs.live-video.net/live-streaming): Documentation for building and managing live streaming workflows.
- [Video Conferencing](https://docs.live-video.net/video-conferencing): Guides and reference material for real-time conferencing applications.
- [Recording](https://docs.live-video.net/recording): Documentation for recording live sessions and media streams.
- [Playback](https://docs.live-video.net/playback): Guides for delivering and controlling video playback experiences.
- [Ingest](https://docs.live-video.net/ingest): Documentation for stream ingest configuration and media input workflows.
- [Transcoding](https://docs.live-video.net/transcoding): Reference and guides for media processing and transcoding pipelines.

## API and Developer Reference
- [REST API](https://docs.live-video.net/api-reference/rest): REST API endpoints for managing live video resources and workflows.
- [Authentication](https://docs.live-video.net/api-reference/authentication): Authentication methods, credentials, and request authorization details.
- [Streams API](https://docs.live-video.net/api-reference/streams): API reference for creating and managing live streams.
- [Rooms API](https://docs.live-video.net/api-reference/rooms): API endpoints for conferencing rooms and participant management.
- [Recordings API](https://docs.live-video.net/api-reference/recordings): Reference for recording creation, retrieval, and lifecycle operations.
- [Webhooks API](https://docs.live-video.net/api-reference/webhooks): API details for configuring and handling webhook events.

## SDKs
- [JavaScript SDK](https://docs.live-video.net/sdks/javascript): SDK documentation for browser and Node.js integrations.
- [React SDK](https://docs.live-video.net/sdks/react): Components and hooks for building live video experiences in React.
- [iOS SDK](https://docs.live-video.net/sdks/ios): Native iOS SDK documentation for mobile live video applications.
- [Android SDK](https://docs.live-video.net/sdks/android): Native Android SDK documentation for real-time media integrations.
- [Flutter SDK](https://docs.live-video.net/sdks/flutter): Cross-platform Flutter SDK for live video and conferencing features.
- [Server SDKs](https://docs.live-video.net/sdks/server): Server-side SDKs for backend orchestration and automation.

## Guides and Tutorials
- [Create a Live Stream](https://docs.live-video.net/guides/create-a-live-stream): Step-by-step guide to creating and starting a live stream.
- [Build a Video Call App](https://docs.live-video.net/guides/build-a-video-call-app): Tutorial for implementing a basic video conferencing application.
- [Enable Recording](https://docs.live-video.net/guides/enable-recording): Guide to configuring and managing recording for sessions and streams.
- [Handle Webhooks](https://docs.live-video.net/guides/handle-webhooks): Practical webhook integration patterns for backend event handling.
- [Secure Playback](https://docs.live-video.net/guides/secure-playback): Guide to protecting playback URLs and controlling viewer access.
- [Token Authentication](https://docs.live-video.net/guides/token-authentication): Tutorial for generating and using access tokens securely.
